state.title: tests/unit/type/zset.tcl

part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `blockingGenericZpopCommand` (src/t_zset.c:4044), which always blocked on `c->argv+1 .. c->argc-2` — correct for BZPOPMIN/BZPOPMAX, but for BZMPOP that range includes the `timeout`, `numkeys`, `MIN|MAX`, and `COUNT` arguments as if they were keys.

The fix uses the `keys`/`numkeys` parameters that are already passed by every caller:

```c
blockForKeys(c,BLOCKED_ZSET,keys,numkeys,count,timeout,NULL,&pos,NULL);
```

- BZPOPMIN/BZPOPMAX pass `c->argv+1, c->argc-2` (unchanged behavior)
- BZMPOP passes `c->argv+numkeys_idx+1, numkeys` (now blocks only on real keys)

Verified: full `unit/type/zset` suite passes, including the regression test "BZMPOP should not blocks on non key arguments - #10762" (tests/unit/type/zset.tcl:2068), and `unit/type/list` (shared `blockForKeys` infrastructure) also passes.
